objective: Adopt the dial-time Gemini session and play its cached greeting immediately on authenticated Vobiz media readiness, once per call
acceptance_criteria: Prepared session is found under outbound tracking, provider request or answered call ID, including a fast-answer race
The first cached audio frame is sent before post-answer lifecycle/database work completes
The same Gemini adapter is adopted for conversation without greeting regeneration
Cached opening is delivered once; duplicate start/pickup events cannot replay it
A silent delivery note and concise prompt prohibit repeated introductions except when caller asks identity
Cleanup cancels early playback and closes any unadopted session
Architecture is recorded for future repository agents; auth and admission gates remain intact
